mechanism: For two series V and S, simple cross if (V[i]-S[i])*(V[i+1]-S[i+1])<0. If V[i+1]==S[i+1] but V[i]!=S[i], walk index until values diverge; mark cross only if end signs disagree, else treat as touch. Library MarkCrosses(CROSS_UP/DOWN/ALL). Emits event bars usable as change sensors on any oscillator pair.

mechanism: Scale each FX cross by LengthSample mean Close. EUR = average of all EUR* crosses /14; USD = average of USD* plus 1/GBPUSD,1/AUDUSD,1/NZDUSD,1/EURUSD /14. Propagate lag compensator Och=EURUSD*USD/EUR from previous bar into both sums. Derive other nationals as (EUR/EURXXX + USD-side)/2. Same for High/Low. Yields synthetic national-currency series and missing crosses.

mechanism: Treat futures Open Interest as the second supply/demand variable (goods volume proxy). Relatively high OI vs its history → high-prices / oversupply phase → prefer shorts; relatively low OI → low-prices / shortage → prefer longs. Implement as Index_OI = 100*(OI-min)/(max-min) over period (26–156 weeks).

mechanism: NetPosition_i = Long_i − Short_i for commercials (operators), non-commercials, or nonreportables. COT Index = 100*(Net−min)/(max−min) over N weeks (N≥26; classic 156). Extremes ≥~80% (or 75%) bullish for that group; ≤~20% (25%) bearish. Operators high net → later upside; funds at max long → downside risk; crowd high net → fade.
data_needed: Weekly CFTC long/short by trader category; period; critical levels as optimizable params.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Wheat, gold, silver, cattle, cotton, GBP, JPY, EURO, sugar, cocoa, soybeans, energy, equity indices, rates; weekly; periods 26/52/104/156

mechanism: WILLCO = Stochastic(NetOperators / OpenInterest) over N weeks (Williams: 26; also 52/156). Combine commercial lean with market size share: WILLCO>80% → peak/short bias; <20% → trough/long bias. Also Percent Position in OI (e.g. operators short share ≥70% / ≤30%) as related structure sensor.
data_needed: Weekly net commercial position and OI; period; 20/80 (or tuned) thresholds.

mechanism: Over a rolling calendar window (e.g. 6 days), bucket bars by open hour:minute on TF∈{M5,M15,M30,H1,H4}. Count bullish/bearish/doji and mean |Open−Close| and High−Low in points per bucket. Walk window daily to track regime evolution.
